Part Number: TBX-850FAW


                                                      SPARKLE Thunderbolt™ 5 eGPU Studio-G Ultra 850 Luna, Thunderbolt™ 5
                                                      80/120 Gbps, 3.5-Slot PCIe Graphics Enclosure, ATX 3.1 850W PSU, USB 3.2 &
                                                      2.5 Gbps Ethernet Ports, Windows Compatible, TBX-850FAW
                                                      Powered by Intel® Barlow Ridge, SPARKLE Thunderbolt™ 5 eGPU Studio-G Ultra 850 Luna is designed
                                                      for boosting up the graphics ability of your laptop by plug-in an external PCIe GPU.
                                                      Studio Series has the biggest ability to fit the latest GPU in the marketing, Studio-G Ultra 850
                                                      supports the GPU with up to 3.5-Slot width and 346mm length; a built-in 850W PSU is ready to face
                                                      any challenge.
